name: go_validation_command_misleading_success
prompt:
Fix the Go Clamp function bug.

Requirements:
- Modify calculator.go only.
- Clamp must return minVal when value is below minVal.
- Clamp must return maxVal when value is above maxVal.
- Clamp must return value unchanged when value is within [minVal, maxVal].
- Do not modify main.go or go.mod.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only Clamp changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: go run .
